title: Of Baptism and the Lord’s Supper
subtitle: Baptism and the Lord's Supper are ordinances of positive and sovereign institution, appointed by Christ to be continued in his church to the end of the world.

paragraphs.text: Baptism and the Lord's Supper are ordinances of positive and sovereign institution, appointed by the Lord Jesus, the only lawgiver, to be continued in his church to the end of the world.
These holy appointments are to be administered by those only who are qualified and called to it according to the commission of Christ.
